title: Infinite Dragon Bridge
description: A surreal night scene on a metal bridge features a skeleton in a cowboy hat holding a gun, a donkey, and a spiky-haired character under string lights, with a fiery sky, a ringed planet, and a city silhouette in the background. Below, a large green and orange dragon forms an infinity symbol while carrying a red-cloaked rider, above a crowd of tiny figures.
prompt: Surreal fantasy painting of a metal bridge at night with string lights, where a cowboy skeleton holding a revolver stands next to a donkey and a spiky-haired character pointing upward. The fiery orange sky contains a ringed planet and dark city towers. In the foreground, a massive green and orange dragon coils into an infinity loop carrying a red-cloaked rider with flowing cape, above a crowd of spectators, vibrant flowers and foliage on the bridge, dramatic and whimsical atmosphere.
